note: Measured off the 19.8M-tri Sphagnum source mesh by experiments/039-nd-moss/bake.ts (NDM1 v4). The mesh has since been deleted; these values cannot be regenerated.

maps.albedo.png: rgb8, linear, coverage-weighted mip convention (already normalised by coverage — do NOT divide by alpha again)
maps.height.png: gray8, 0 = y0, 255 = y1 (see y0/y1, metres at mesh scale 1)
maps.normal.png: rgb8, plain xyz * 0.5 + 0.5, upper hemisphere. NOT octahedral — this map is mipped and octahedral pairs are not mip-averageable.
maps.ao.png: gray8, cavity AO from a wrapping horizon sweep, 8 azimuths x 5 radii (1.05-16.9mm)
